job.job_description:
Notice Period-Immedite-10 days




The Python Backend L5 is a senior technical leadership role focused on architecting and delivering highconcurrency RESTful APIs using Python, preferably with FastAPI (or Flask). The role owns endtoend backend design, testing strategy, deployment, and operations on Google Cloud Platform. It requires deep expertise in data structures, algorithms, and system design to build scalable, resilient services. The leader mentors a team of 4+ engineers, drives engineering excellence and automated quality, and resolves critical production issues using a firstprinciples approach.




Required Qualifications

12+ years of professional software development with strong emphasis on Python
Expertise building highconcurrency RESTful APIs
Mastery of FastAPI (highly preferred) or strong Flask experience
Handson architecture and deployment on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Expertlevel unit testing, integration testing, and automated QA (e.g., pytest)
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and system design patterns
Proven experience as Technical Lead or Lead Developer for a team of 4+ engineers
Exceptional communication with nontechnical stakeholders
Firstprinciples problem solving for critical production incidents
Bonus: Frontend literacy (React/Angular/Vue) for crossteam collaboration
Bonus: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or Pulumi)
Bonus: Orchestration experience (e.g., container/workflow orchestration)



Responsibilities

Own backend architecture and system design for highthroughput Python services
Design, build, and optimize RESTful APIs using FastAPI (or Flask) with asynchronous/concurrent patterns
Deploy, operate, and scale services on GCP; select appropriate compute, storage, and networking services
Define and enforce testing strategy (unit, integration, automation) and quality gates
Lead and mentor a team of 4+ engineers; conduct code reviews and set engineering standards
Troubleshoot and resolve critical production issues using firstprinciples root cause analysis
Collaborate with product, frontend (React/Angular/Vue), and other stakeholders to align on API contracts
Establish observability (logging, metrics, tracing), performance tuning, and costoptimization practices
Champion best practices in system design, resiliency, and maintainable code; document architectures and decisions
